_comment: QI Scheduled-Task Window Policy. Single source of truth for which Windows scheduled tasks may pop a console window. Apply with: python C:\QIH\tools\qi_task_window_manager.py --apply   |   Verify: ...--verify   |   Dry-run (default): ...(no flag). window_mode: 'hidden_user' (default, NO admin needed) = task still runs as you, but the window is suppressed: python.exe is swapped to pythonw.exe (windowless), and wsl/.bat/other console programs are wrapped in 'conhost.exe --headless' (Win11 headless host). Keeps full user profile (git creds, WSL, venvs). 'system' = re-home to SYSTEM/ServiceAccount (session 0, invisible) - loses user profile, needs admin to change, only for self-contained scripts. 'visible' = unwrap and restore normal interactive (debugging). enabled:false = Disable-ScheduledTask.

QI_BrainBackfill.note: python.exe every 30 min -> the periodic offender

QI_NightlyGitSync.note: python.exe overnight; needs user git creds -> keep as user

MaiaNightlySync.note: python.exe overnight; git push needs user creds

OC_WSL_KeepAlive.note: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden; S4U makes it bulletproof (RunLevel Highest)
